descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己做的纸菜单在盘边留了几粒跑远的面包屑。
descriptions.en: My homemade menu leaves a few travelling crumbs at the plate’s edge.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的纸菜单记着两份苹果卷，一份先尝苹果，一份先尝面皮。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu remembers two portions of strudel, started with apple and pastry respectively.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在纸签上压出错开的两个小阶，不抄录任何现成乐谱。
descriptions.en: Two staggered folds I pressed into a tab recall our steps without copying a score.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使剪的两个大小方框，记着望远镜拿反后的远景。
descriptions.en: Two differently sized paper frames I cut recall the view through reversed binoculars.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自折的长卡在每道短痕间留空，记着大家没有抢下一步的声音。
descriptions.en: My original folded card leaves room between short marks for sounds that waited their turn.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己剪的小纸人连背包都歪着，记着摩天轮旁的问候。
descriptions.en: My original paper figure leans with its bag, recalling a wave beside the Ferris wheel.
